title: Night Raiders and the Rally
changes: When one clan holds clearly the most land, the Night Raiders hunt it: each night they strike two of its border lands and thin its army, and the riders go for its soldiers, carts and sworn heroes first.
The clan with the least land gets a Rally: its sworn heroes' valor counts 30% more, their renown grows 25% faster, and its war writs pay more.
The Herald announces both. The war table marks the hunted clan, the Rally and the lands the Raiders struck; the front plaque shows them too.
